facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced by fact_new_1 and fact_new_2: Wayman changed the deal so the goblins keep the upper mound and wall off the stairs instead

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the goblins no longer need the mound cleared, and Sir Alfred was left incapacitated

facts.text: Wayman Tisdale promised Snurk of the Free Goblin Society never to tell King Hogboon where the goblins are.

The Free Goblin Society, friendly to the party, now holds the upper Barrow Mound (church, antechamber and statue room) and is walling off the stairs, keeping Sir Alfred sealed below; they mean to destroy the church there.
